mapper.select: SELECT id FROM members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mp.name AS product_name, mp.product_type, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, mm.remaining_pt_sessions, CASE WHEN mm.status='ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE mm.status END AS status, CASE WHEN mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) END AS remaining_days FROM members m JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.member_id=m.id JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id=mm.product_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY mm.start_date DESC, mm.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS attendance_id, a.attendance_date, a.checked_in_at, a.checked_out_at FROM attendances a JOIN members m ON m.id=a.member_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY a.checked_in_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT wr.id AS routine_id, wr.title, wr.description, wr.start_date, wr.end_date, re.exercise_name, re.target_sets, re.target_reps_min, re.target_reps_max, re.target_weight, re.day_of_week, re.display_order FROM members m JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.member_id=m.id LEFT JOIN routine_exercises re ON re.routine_id=wr.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND wr.status='ACTIVE' AND wr.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (wr.end_date IS NULL OR wr.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY wr.start_date DESC, wr.id DESC, re.display_order, re.id

SELECT ws.id AS session_id, COALESCE(wr.title,'개인 운동') AS routine_title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, ws.memo, COUNT(DISTINCT wset.exercise_name) AS exercise_count FROM members m JOIN workout_sessions ws ON ws.member_id=m.id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id=ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id=ws.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY ws.id, wr.title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, ws.memo ORDER BY ws.started_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT m.id AS member_id, lc.login_id, m.name, m.phone, m.birth_date, m.gender, u.email, m.status, (SELECT MIN(DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE)) FROM member_memberships mm WHERE mm.member_id=m.id AND mm.status='ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.attendance_date) FROM attendances a WHERE a.member_id=m.id AND a.attendance_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND a.attendance_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS monthly_attendance_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mm.remaining_pt_sessions) FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id=mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id=m.id AND mm.status='ACTIVE' AND mm.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND mp.product_type IN ('PT','COMBINED')),0) AS remaining_pt_sessions FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id=u.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET name=#{form.name}, phone=#{form.phone}, birth_date=#{form.birthDate}, gender=#{form.gender}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET email=#{email}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT ws.id AS session_id, ws.routine_id, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, wset.exercise_name, COUNT(wset.id) AS sets, MAX(wset.weight) AS weight, MAX(wset.reps) AS reps, ws.memo FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id=ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id=ws.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND ws.id=#{sessionId} GROUP BY ws.id, ws.routine_id, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, wset.exercise_name, ws.memo ORDER BY wset.exercise_name LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_sessions(member_id, routine_id, started_at, ended_at, memo) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{routineId}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{memo})
INSERT INTO workout_sets(session_id, exercise_name, set_number, weight, reps, completed) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{exerciseName}, #{setNumber}, #{weight}, #{reps}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_sessions SET routine_id=#{routineId}, started_at=#{startedAt}, ended_at=#{endedAt}, memo=#{memo}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{sessionId} AND member_id=#{memberId}
